latvia.description: There's a Baltic football derby taking place on Saturday with Latvia visiting southern neighbours Lithuania in the Baltic Cup tournament.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 5th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Pre-election period starts in Latvia with a wary eye on AI influence
latvia.description: On Saturday, June 6th, the official pre-election campaign period for the 15th Saeima elections begins in Latvia, which will last until election day itself – October 3rd. The pre-election period runs for 120 days.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Romania men's volleyball
latvia.description: The Latvian men's national volleyball team head coach Ugis Krastiņš is set to make his debut at the helm on June 5th when Latvia takes on Romania.

latvia.title: WATCH: Opening session of the EBRD board of governors meeting
latvia.description: The opening session of the EBRD Board of Governors will take place on the afternoon of Friday, 5 June 2026.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Grand Fair, Choir Picnic, Daugavpils festival
latvia.description: What will you do this weekend? Perhaps try one of these?

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Romania women's volleyball
latvia.description: In preparation for the European Championship, the Latvian women's national team will host the Romanian and Israeli teams in the first round of the European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) European League in Riga on June 5 and 7.

latvia.title: Summer boating season is in full swing on the River Abava
latvia.description: The boating season is currently in full swing. There are several dozen rivers suitable for boating in Latvia, but many are especially fond of the picturesque Gauja, the rapid Brasla and the winding Abava, which can be divided into two sections - the 'tame' and the 'wild'.

latvia.title: No swimming in Kolka due to faecal contamination
latvia.description: The Health Inspectorate reported on June 5 that intestinal enterococci, or faecal contamination, have been detected in the sea at the Kolka swimming area in western Latvia, and swimming there is therefore prohibited.

latvia.title: Fire alarm at Rīga hospital caused confusion over patient evacuation
latvia.description: The sounding of a fire alarm at a major Rīga hospital this week caused confusion, according to a Latvian Radio report.

latvia.title: Dutch company to build biomethane plant in Latvia
latvia.description: Next Biogas SIA, a subsidiary of the Dutch HoSt Group, will build a biomethane production plant in Lēdurga, Sigulda Municipality, for 26.8 million euros, and on Friday, the company signed a loan agreement with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to implement the project, LETA reports.

latvia.title: Fuel prices down 4.7% last month in Latvia
latvia.description: The data of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB), published on 5 June, show that in May 2026, compared to April 2026, the average level of consumer prices of fuels for transport decreased by 4.7 %.

latvia.title: French citizen detained for migrant smuggling in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 4, border guards in the Augšdaugava Municipality detained a French citizen for transporting individuals who had crossed the state border illegally, the State Border Guard said in a release.

latvia.title: Sun will return on Sunday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that it will rain in many parts of Latvia on Saturday, but Sunday will be sunnier, according to weatherman Toms Bricis.

latvia.title: Look out for low-flying Swedish jets on Saturday
latvia.description: On Saturday, June 6, Sweden's National Day, Swedish Air Force JAS 39 Gripen fighter jets will perform a flyover over Latvia. They will be visible above Riga Castle and the Freedom Monument at around 13:45.

latvia.title: 'BALTOPS 26' military drills happening in Baltic Sea region
latvia.description: The annual international military exercise “BALTOPS 26” will take place in the Baltic Sea region, including Latvia, from June 4 to 19.

latvia.title: Allied troops stationed in Daugavpils, Latvia
latvia.description: The NATO Multinational Brigade has deployed troops in Daugavpils for the first time, expanding its presence beyond the Ādaži military base. In the future, allied forces are also planned to be deployed elsewhere in Latgale, thereby demonstrating NATO’s readiness to defend the entire territory of Latvia if necessary, according to the portal Sargs.lv.

latvia.description: While recent attention in security discussions has focused on drones crossing Latvian airspace, we must not forget that another critical area of defence is our cyberspace and critical digital infrastructure.

latvia.title: New Latvian media watchdog head confirmed
latvia.description: With the Saeima’s approval of the dismissal of National Electronic Media Council (NEPLP) Chair Ivars Āboliņš from his position as a council member, Aurēlija Ieva Druviete was elected as the new NEPLP Chair, the council told the LETA news agency on June 4.

latvia.title: Latvian police claim major weed bust
latvia.description: This week, State Police officers detained four members of a criminal group in connection with the illegal sale of narcotic and psychotropic substances on a large scale.

latvia.title: Latvian security service publishes new Russian 'lawfare' report
latvia.description: The Constitution Protection Bureau (SAB), one of Latvia's three security services, has published a new report titled "RUSSIA INTENSIFIES LAWFARE AGAINST THE WEST TO JUSTIFY MORE AGGRESSIVE ACTIVITIES".

latvia.title: EBRD meeting in Rīga
latvia.description: On 5–7 June 2026, the 35th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and Business Forum will take place in Rīga at the Radisson Blu Latvija Conference Hotel, though with entertainment laid on and other meetings at venues such as the Dailes Theatre and Latvian National Museum of Art.

latvia.description: Korupcijas novēršanas un apkarošanas birojs (KNAB) rosina prokuratūru sākt kriminālvajāšanu pret bijušo Rēzeknes domes priekšsēdētāju Aleksandru Bartaševiču (Kopā Latvijai/LPV) par iespējamu dienesta stāvokļa ļaunprātīgu izmantošanu un prettiesiski pašvaldības vārdā noslēgtu līgumu ar būvfirmu par tukšā Rēzeknes rekreācijas centra projekta turpināšanu, noskaidroja aģentūra LETA. lithuania.title: A rák én vagyok, de több is vagyok nála
lithuania.description: Májusban jelent meg Urfi Péter első könyve, a Sansz, amely egyszerre idézi fel a covid időszakának sokszor már elfeledett történéseit és szól arról, hogy mit is jelent mindaz, amikor az embernél váratlanul agydaganatot diagnosztizálnak. lithuania.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

lithuania.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

lithuania.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
lithuania.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

lithuania.title: Háromszáz méteren szakadt le a felsővezeték a miskolci vasútvonalon
lithuania.description: Vámosgyörk és Ludas között csak egy vágányon közlekedhetnek a vonatok, Vámosgyörk és Füzesabony közt pedig a személyvonatok ideiglenesen nem járnak.

lithuania.title: „Ferrari a levegőben” – élőben néztük meg, mit tudnak az ukrán elfogódrónok, amikért a fél világ sorban áll
lithuania.description: Ukrajna feltalálta a csapásmérő drónok ellenszerét, rémálmot hozva ezzel a háborús kiadásokat számoló orosz könyvelőknek. Ilyen technológiát és tudást akar most vásárolni az Öböl-monarchiáktól a NATO-ig mindenki.

lithuania.title: Drónok sértették meg két európai ország légterét, nagy területszerzésekről számolt be az ukrán főparancsnok – Ukrajnai háborús híreink hétfőn
lithuania.description: Lettország és Moldova légterét is megsértette hétfőre virradóra egy-egy berepülő drón. A lett légtérbe tévedő drónt a NATO vadászgépei lőtték le, a moldovai légteret megsértő drón egy település közelében zuhant le. Olekszandr Szirszkij ukrán főparancsnok szerint az ukrán haderő idén már több mint 600 km²-nyi területet szabadított fel az orosz megszállás alól. Csak májusban 100 km²-rel több területet hódítottak vissza az ukránok, mint amekkorát az oroszok megszereztek. Ezek alátámasztják azokat a korábbi megfigyelői számításokat, melyek szerint a 2023-as ukrán ellentámadás óta idén májusban először lett negatív az orosz területszerzés mérlege. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az ukrajnai háború eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Katonai drón lépett be egy NATO-tagállam légterébe, azonnal riasztották a vadászgépeket
lithuania.description: NATO-vadászgépek lőttek le egy drónt Lettország légterében hétfőn – írja a Reuters .

lithuania.title: Węgry sprawdzają statusy uchodźców. Gawkowski do Ziobry i Romanowskiego: zapraszamy też nad Wisłę
lithuania.description: Zbigniew Ziobro i Marcin Romanowski muszą stawić się przed węgierskim urzędem, aby przedstawić dowody uzasadniające utrzymanie statusu uchodźcy. Z Budapesztu do Warszawy niedaleko, więc zapraszamy też nad Wisłę, bo jest kilka spraw do uregulowania - napisał wicepremier, minister cyfryzacji Krzysztof Gawkowski. Sprawę komentował też minister koordynator służb specjalnych Tomasz Siemoniak.

lithuania.title: Babiš drží Pavla mimo hry. Prezident má pripravenú žalobu pre summit NATO
lithuania.description: Rozhodnutie o zložení českej delegácie na summit Severoatlantickej aliancie v Ankare nepadlo.

lithuania.title: Kompetenční žalobu prezidenta bych považoval za akt nepřátelství, řekl Macinka
lithuania.description: Předseda Motoristů a ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka se na závěr pondělní tiskové konference po jednání vlády krátce vyjádřil k tomu, jak probíhalo jednání kabinetu za účasti prezidenta Petra Pavla. Pokud by hlava státu sáhla ke kompetenční žalobě, považoval by to Macinka za akt nepřátelství, slova o žalobě však podle něj na jednání kabinetu nikdo nepoužil. Spor se týká toho, zda bude či nebude Pavel součástí delegace na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře.

lithuania.title: Babišova vláda učinila „chytrý tah“, může se vyhnout žalobě prezidenta
lithuania.description: Schválení účasti prezidenta Petra Pavla na summitu OSN v New Yorku byl ze strany vlády Andreje Babiše (ANO) chytrý tah. Pavla mohlo zdržet od podání kompetenční žaloby kvůli summitu NATO, případně jej od ní odradit úplně. Vláda se má definitivně vyjádřit k obsazení delegace do turecké Ankary 22. června. Pokud Pavlovi nevyjde vstříc, nebude mít na spor u Ústavního soudu mnoho času.

lithuania.title: Letouny NATO v Lotyšsku sestřelily dron letící z Ruska
lithuania.description: Do vzdušného prostoru Lotyšska v pondělí dopoledne pronikl dron z Ruska, následně jej sestřelil francouzský stíhací letoun pobaltské mise NATO. Jde o další z řady bezpilotních letounů, které v posledních dnech a týdnech vzbudily obavy v pobaltských státech či Finsku, jež v některých případech přisuzují vinu za jejich přelety Ukrajině, která se už pátým rokem brání ruské agresi.

lithuania.title: Militari români și americani s-au antrenat împreună în Polonia. Mesajul Ambasadei SUA la București
lithuania.description: Militari români și americani au participat la un antrenament comun în Polonia, iar imaginile au fost preluate de Ambasada SUA la București. Exercițiul militar a avut loc la Bemowo Piskie, unde este staționat Grupul de Luptă Multinațional al NATO în Polonia.

lithuania.title: Avioane NATO au doborât o dronă intrată în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia
lithuania.description: Avioane NATO au doborât luni o dronă care a intrat în spațiul aerian al Letoniei dinspre Rusia, după ce autoritățile au emis avertizări pentru locuitorii din estul țării să se adăpostească. Originea aparatului de zbor nu a fost stabilită imediat.

lithuania.title: Cum vor SUA să forțeze Iranul să ofere informații despre instalațiile nucleare bombardate și stocul de uraniu îmbogățit
lithuania.description: Statele Unite fac lobby pe lângă alte ţări din Consiliul Guvernatorilor al Agenţiei Internaţionale pentru Energie Atomică (AIEA) să sprijine un proiect de rezoluţie care ar dispune Iranului să informeze acest organism cu privire la situaţia instalaţiilor sale nucleare bombardate anul trecut şi anul acesta de SUA şi Israel, precum a uraniului îmbogăţit depozitat acolo, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Metz Handball a câştigat în premieră Liga Campionilor, după ce a trecut în finală de Gyor, deținătoarea trofeului
lithuania.description: Metz Handball a devenit prima echipă franceză care câştigă Liga Campionilor la handbal feminin, după ce a învins-o în finală pe Gyori Audi ETO KC, deţinătoarea trofeului, cu 31-29 (18-17), duminică, în MVM Dome din Budapesta, în timp ce CSM Bucureşti a obţinut medaliile de bronz.

lithuania.title: Trump și trupele din Europa: o strategie cu milioane de dolari în joc. „Armata SUA și aliații europeni achită nota”
lithuania.description: Directivele contradictorii ale președintelui american Donald Trump privind efectivele militare americane din Europa au perturbat planificarea militară, au creat confuzie în rândul aliaților NATO și au generat costuri neprevăzute de milioane de dolari. Anularea rotațiilor, schimbările bruște de poziție și orientările neclare din partea Pentagonului au pus presiune pe bugete, au afectat pregătirea trupelor și au destabilizat familiile militarilor. Oficialii avertizează că retragerile mai ample - în special din Germania - ar putea costa miliarde de dolari și dura ani de zile, arată, într-o analiză, Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: „Super-Sparta” lui Netanyahu. Cum a ajuns războiul să coste Israelul 120 de miliarde de euro
lithuania.description: Prim-ministrul israelian Benjamin Netanyahu doreşte să transforme ţara sa într-o „super-Sparta” a Orientului Mijlociu, însă costurile exorbitante ale războiului umflă bugetul apărării şi stârnesc temeri privind reduceri în domeniul educaţiei sau al sănătăţii, potrivit AFP. Costul conflictului declanşat la 7 octombrie 2023 de atacul fără precedent al mişcării islamiste palestiniene asupra Israelului din Gaza se ridica la sfârşitul lunii aprilie la 405 miliarde de shekeli (n.r. aproape 120 de miliarde de euro), potrivit guvernatorului Băncii Centrale Israeliene, Amir Yaron.

lithuania.title: Favoritul pentru ministerul Apărării: ambasadorul României la NATO, care lucrează în MAE de 24 de ani

Numele lui nu este unul atât de cunoscut publicului larg. Neculăescu este însă diplomat de carieră și în prezent ambasadorul României la NATO.  Dan Neculăescu, în vârstă de 51 de ani, a fost numit reprezentant permanent …

lithuania.description: The first ever downing of a foreign drone in Latvian airspace on Monday, June 8th confirms the NATO alliance's determination to protect every centimetre of the country, Brigadier General Ilmārs Atis Lejiņš, Deputy Commander of NATO's Multinational Division "North", said on the Latvian Radio programme 'Krustpunktā' ('At the Crossroads').

lithuania.title: Rothko Museum opens Summer season in Daugavpils
lithuania.description: On Friday, 5th June, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils opened its summer exhibition season, bringing together photography, painting and ceramics from Latvia, Lithuania, China and South Africa.

lithuania.title: Rīga meeting helps advance single Baltic capital market concept
